- n9 -- misspellings -- okay
- n10 -- slang"] -- vital
- n11 -- ["BiLSTM‑CNN models beat dictionary baselines on informal user posts"] -- vital
- n12 -- ["Social media delivers real‑time signals but requires aggressive filtering to avoid pharmacist overload"] -- vital
- n13 -- ["Literature abstracts/case reports yield ADE NER precision >0.90 but low recall; only published events captured"] -- vital
- n14 -- ["Extraction from literature uses UMLS/SNOMED and causality cue patterns"] -- okay
- n15 -- ["Hybrid pipeline normalizes EHR to RxNorm/MedDRA -- vital
- n16 -- social media to consumer vocab -- vital
- n17 -- literature to UMLS"] -- vital
- n18 -- ["Cross‑domain training with domain adaptation boosts robustness across data types"] -- okay
- n19 -- ["Active learning with pharmacist curation balances precision/recall and reduces labeling cost"] -- vital
- n20 -- ["Set high confidence thresholds for pharmacist review to control false‑positive workload"] -- okay
- n21 -- ["Integrate extracted ADE tuples into dashboards; trigger alerts when frequency exceeds statistical threshold"] -- okay
- n22 -- ["Sentence‑boundary and tokenization errors critically affect EHR NER accuracy"] -- okay
- n23 -- ["Privacy: de‑identify EHR data; use public‑domain social media under no‑consent rules for emergencies"] -- okay
- n24 -- ["Evaluation metrics: F1 -- okay
- n25 -- precision -- okay
- n26 -- recall -- okay
- n27 -- false‑discovery rate for end‑to‑end assessment"] -- okay
- n28 -- ["Twitter‑like posts are ultra‑short -- okay
- n29 -- noisy; require slang lexicon and normalization before NER/RE" -- okay
